G_system: Please reason step by step, and put your final answer within \boxed{}.
G_user_suffix: Give a complete solution. End with exactly one final answer in \boxed{...}. Use the mathematical form requested in the question. Do not add another answer after the box.
V_system: Judge whether the FINAL ANSWER in the candidate response correctly answers the question. Work out the answer independently. A means the final answer is correct; B means it is incorrect. Judge final-answer correctness, not the completeness of the explanation. Respond with exactly A or B.
answer_protocol: boxed_v2: balanced braces; explicit boxed/hash answers only; units or descriptive suffix allowed when no later conflicting math assertion; repeated boxes must normalize equivalently; truncation always unresolved; MATH exact rational/symbolic equality via restricted LaTeX Lark parser, never execute generated code; unsupported or undecidable equivalence remains unknown
final_test_policy: Never infer on old T or conditional new T. All 100 DAPO development families excluded from formal pools. DAPO internal heldout derives only from public training data; no contamination-free claim.
scope: DAPO development and length diagnostic; conditional disjoint pool construction; no G/V parameter training
source_revision_caveat: Processed dataset does not pin its parent revision; exact parent mapping cannot be asserted. Source prompts and UUIDs retained.
family_rule: Connected components: equal normalized question hash, same source UUID, or >=8 shared word trigrams and >=80% containment of shorter trigram set. Candidate retrieval via postings <=200 documents; approximate near-family coverage, not semantic identity proof.
eligibility: English subset, verify no CJK; text only without explicit diagram markup/reference; prompt<=1024 to fit uniform 3072 output within native4096; exclude families touching prior A/B/C/T or MATH70; no answer/difficulty/output-based selection
sampling: seed42 shuffle sorted family IDs; take one representative per family; first100 development before generation; reserve rest for conditional formal pools
